newsitem.title: PAPUA NEW GUINEA: Rugby League - Johns leads Australia to 52-6 win.
newsitem.headline: Rugby League - Johns leads Australia to 52-6 win.

text.p: Utility player Andrew Johns scored a try and kicked eight goals for a personal tally of 20 points on Sunday as Australia beat Papua New Guinea 52-6 at the Lloyd Robson Oval.

The Australians ran in nine tries after trailing by six points when Papau New Guinea scrum-half Adrian Lam, who plays in the Australian Rugby League premiership competition, regathered his own short kick over the Australian defence to score.
The lead was shortlived as the Australians hit back soon after and took a halftime lead of 28-6 before wrapping up the game in the second half.

The match, watched by a crowd of 8,000, was played against the backdrop of threats of disruption by secessionists from the nearby island of Bougainville. The Australian Broadcasting Corporation said 400 army and police personnel were on hand before the match.
However, the only skirmishes outside the ground were between security forces and fans unable to get tickets for the game.
